class.name: NeedleEngine
class.brief_description: On-device tool calling (Needle 3) and speech-to-text (Whistle) from Cactus Compute.
class.description: Singleton wrapping Needle's native engine. The engine keeps one process-global text model, one speech model and one conversation, and is not thread-safe; every method here takes an internal lock. Load needle3.cact and optionally whistle.cact with [method load_model], declare tools with [method configure], then call [method complete] or [method complete_audio]. Audio is 16 kHz mono float PCM in [-1, 1]. Calls block, so run them off the main thread.
